# License archive

QuickLang itself: root LICENSE (Apache-2.0).
Ink content: CC-BY-SA-4.0; the import tool bundles the exact upstream license and attribution with generated content.
No Ink/Mnemosyne/LibreLingo software source is incorporated.

Third-party npm metadata is generated in build/compliance/dependencies.json.
This framework is not a distribution-ready license audit of every Rust dependency.
